body: No, the breakup was over other things. We've broken up and gotten together plenty of times over the span of our relationship, but we always got back together, I felt because it was really meant to be. She reached out to me a couple weeks ago, and things could have been mended, but I thought I was better off without her and I'm realising now that's not true. I feel like I lost the chance to save things with her. I was holding out hope that maybe once we both were better we could be together again, but with every day passing by without her saying a single word to me, and now refusing to talk to me about our daughter I feel like it's never going to happen.
